description: Sol addition A. Spacing around binary operators in already-explicit symbolic expressions.

context_requirements.scope: expressions already emitted as symbolic math in prose or display lines
context_requirements.consistency: each site is one operator instance; no requirement of global consistency (inconsistency within a trace is itself a legal random outcome)

exclusions: unary operators (unary minus, negation) — EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED per freeze
ambiguous minus (could parse as unary or range/hyphen) — skip when the matcher cannot prove binary reading
code blocks where whitespace is syntactically meaningful — EXCLUDED per freeze
anything where parsing changes (e.g., '**' exponent, '->' arrows, negative exponents)
numeral-internal characters; digit<->word substitution is a DISPUTED CELL, never this rule

registered_predictions.sol_depth_interaction: weak positive (available carrier if neutral state is reused)
